researchSummary.finding: CRITICAL GEOGRAPHY MISMATCH. The only publicly identifiable operator trading as 'Gone Mountain Biking' (gonemountainbiking.com) is based in Pickering, North Yorkshire, England — not Wales. They operate in Dalby Forest and the North York Moors National Park. No operator trading as 'Gone Mountain Biking' in Wales was found through any accessible public source. 'Gone Mountain Biking' does not appear in Visit Wales directories, MBWales.com agent listings, TripAdvisor Wales sections, or any Wales-specific tourism source. The Adventure Wales content inventory entry has no confirmed region, no activity type, a quality score of 15, and a confidence score of 45 — consistent with a low-confidence or erroneous entry.
